### Summary

```dockerfile
FROM python:3.14-slim
COPY --from=ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:0.12.15 /uv /uvx /bin/
COPY pyproject.toml .
COPY uv.lock .

ARG UV_DEFAULT_INDEX
ENV UV_DEFAULT_INDEX=${UV_DEFAULT_INDEX}

ENV UV_INDEX_STRATEGY=unsafe-any-match
RUN uv sync --no-cache -v --frozen
```

```shell
docker build  --build-arg UV_DEFAULT_INDEX="https://a.fr/repository/pypi-org-proxy/simple/" -t test . --no-cache --progress=plain
```

Do not use my custom INDEX

but if I remove `--frozen` it works


`--frozen` should not disable the UV_INDEX_STRATEGY

Thanks


### Platform

ubuntu 24.04

### Version

0.12.15

### Python version

3.14
title: frozen block UV_DEFAULT_INDEX and UV_INDEX_STRATEGY
